{{Quote|It's a strategic assessment of the Ortolan geothermal power station. Maps, avenues of attack...|Cadix|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Cadix''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Outpost Cresh]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he helped decipher sensitive information retrieved from a corpse of a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] defector by a Republic citizen.<ref name="TOR" />
